intro.title: About this system
items: Open Mail Room helps your organization manage the mailroom: registering incoming mail, AI recognition, notifying recipients, counter pickup verification, outbound shipping, and reporting.
The system shows different features depending on your role (admin/counter/employee/read-only) — you'll only see what's relevant to your job.

loginLogout.title: Signing in / out
items: Enter your email and password on the sign-in page and click "Sign in".
Once signed in, use the "Log out" button at the bottom of the left navigation (bottom bar on mobile) to end your session — always log out on a shared device.

myMailCommon.title: Viewing your own mail
items: Click "My Mail" in the navigation to see items waiting for you and your pickup history.
If your account is linked to a directory employee record, your personal pickup code is shown at the top of the page.

myMail.title: My Mail
items: "My Mail" lists packages currently ready for pickup, as well as your past pickup history.
Click an item to see details such as sender and received time.

notifications.title: Notification bindings (LINE/Email…)
items: On "Notification Settings" you can bind LINE, Telegram, Email and other channels to get notified when mail arrives or a reminder is due.
LINE/Telegram use a binding-code flow: scan the QR code or add the bot, then send the 6-digit code shown on screen to complete the binding.
Other channels like Email can be added directly by entering an address; the status shows "Pending" or "Verified".
Click "Unbind" any time to remove a channel you no longer need.

pickupCode.title: Using your pickup code
items: Your pickup code is your personal proof of pickup, shown at the top of "My Mail".
Show or tell the counter staff this code to verify pickup quickly, without needing a signature.
Treat your pickup code as private — only share it if you're authorizing someone else to pick up on your behalf.

inboundRegister.title: Registering mail (manual / photo / batch)
items: Manual registration: fill in the mail type, recipient, etc. on "Manual Registration" and submit — the system matches the employee directory and sends a notification automatically.

Photo registration: use the camera on "Register Package" to capture the mail label; the system scans for a barcode and sends it for AI recognition. You can capture multiple items in a row, or add more photos to the same item.
Batch upload: select up to 30 photos at once, merge selected photos into one item if needed, then create AI recognition jobs for all of them.
All three flows finish on the "OCR Confirmation" page. If you go offline, captures/uploads are queued and sync automatically once you're back online.

ocrConfirm.title: OCR confirmation
items: After AI recognition finishes, "OCR Confirmation" shows one item at a time with the photo on one side and editable fields on the other.
Low-confidence fields are flagged — double check them before confirming. Every field can be edited manually.
Confirming creates the official record and sends the notification automatically; you can also "Skip this item" to handle it later.

pickup.title: Pickup / verification
items: Find the employee and their pending items by "Search by name" or "Enter pickup code".
Select the items being picked up, then enter the name of the actual recipient (or delegate).
Verify with either a "Touch signature" or the "Pickup code" method — if signing isn't possible, use the pickup code instead.
After submitting, the result of each item's verification is shown immediately.

outbound.title: Outbound shipping
items: Create an outbound item on "Outbound": enter the applicant (auto-matched against the directory), recipient details, carrier, and payment method, then submit.
Once the package actually ships, click "Mark shipped" on the list — enter the tracking number manually, or take a photo and use OCR to fill it in automatically.
Filter the outbound list by status (pending/shipped/delivered/exception).

search.title: Search
items: "Search" lets you filter received mail by keyword (tracking no. / name / department), status, carrier, department, and date range.
Click "View detail" to expand the full information for a single item.

employees.title: Employee directory & CSV import
items: On "Employee Directory" you can add/edit employee records (name, aliases, department, extension, email, phone, active status).
"Aliases" can hold an employee's English name or common nicknames, improving OCR/manual name-matching accuracy.
Click "Download CSV template" for the expected column format, then use "Import CSV" to bulk create/update employees — the import result shows a success/failure count and a per-row error reason.

aiSettings.title: AI Settings
items: The AI Settings page shows whether an AI API key is configured, the provider, and today's used/limit request count. The API key must be set via a host environment variable (AI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY) and cannot be entered on this page for security reasons.
Choose a model from the dropdown, or keep "Auto-detect (recommended)". The list is fetched live from the configured provider; the dropdown is disabled if no key is configured yet.
The "daily request limit" prevents abuse (default 10000/day) and can be adjusted (1-100000).

webhooks.title: Notification webhooks
items: On "Webhooks" you can add endpoints for external systems and choose which events to subscribe to (e.g. received, picked up, outbound shipped).
A signing secret (for verifying the source) is shown once at creation — copy and store it immediately, as it can't be viewed again after leaving the page.
Use "Test" to confirm an endpoint responds correctly; consecutive failures are shown as a count, and an endpoint can be disabled if needed.
"Notification Failures" lets you view failed notification deliveries and resend them manually.

auditLogs.title: Audit logs
items: "Audit Logs" records who created/modified/deleted/viewed which record and when — including views of confidential items.
Filter by actor, action, target type/ID, and date range, and view the detailed diff for any entry.

retention.title: Data retention
items: Personal data (name, department, contact info) is retained per the configured privacy policy — 5 years by default — and is anonymized or deleted after that.
To adjust the retention period or help a user exercise their access/deletion rights, use the admin settings or contact your technical owner.

viewer.title: Read-only access
items: Your account has the "Read-only" role: you can use "Search" and "Reports" to view mail and outbound records, but cannot create, edit, or verify any record.
Contact the counter staff or an administrator if a record needs to change.

hint.dashboard: This is the mailroom home page — jump to photo registration, batch upload, or pickup, and see today's stats and the pickup-ready list.
hint.myMail: See packages waiting for you and your pickup history, plus your personal pickup code.
hint.inboundRegister: Manually enter mail details to create a record — handy when there's no camera or for quick single-item entry.
hint.photoRegister: Use the camera to capture the mail label; the system scans for a barcode and sends it for AI recognition.
hint.batchUpload: Select multiple photos at once, optionally merge them into one item, then create AI recognition jobs in batch.
hint.ocrConfirm: Review the AI recognition result — low-confidence fields are flagged — then confirm to create the official record.
hint.pickup: Look up pending items by name or pickup code, then verify pickup with a signature or the pickup code.
hint.outbound: Create outbound items, capture a waybill photo to OCR the tracking number, and track shipping status.
hint.reports: View received/outbound stats by date range and department/carrier/day grouping, and export detail CSVs.
hint.search: Filter mail records by tracking number, name, department, status, and more, and view full details.
hint.employees: Manage the employee directory — add/edit employees, or bulk import via CSV.
hint.auditLogs: View the system's audit trail — who created/modified/deleted/viewed which record and when.
hint.employeesCsvTemplate: CSV columns: name, aliases (semicolon-separated), department_code, ext, email, phone. Download the template, fill it in, then import.
hint.inboundCarrier: Carrier is optional and used for search/reporting later — leave it blank if none match.
hint.inboundTrackingNo: Enter the number from the mail/waybill; leave blank if there isn't one — the system still assigns an internal item number.
hint.inboundRecipientMatch: The recipient name is auto-matched against the employee directory: score ≥90 auto-fills, 70–90 lists candidates to confirm, <70 requires manual entry.
hint.outboundCarrier: Choose the carrier actually used for this shipment — shown on the outbound list and in reports.
hint.outboundPayment: Choose how this shipment is paid for: company account, department code, or personal.
hint.outboundApplicantMatch: The applicant name is auto-matched against the employee directory using the same rule as mail registration (≥90 auto-fill, 70–90 candidates).
hint.outboundTrackingNo: Enter the tracking number manually, or take a photo and click "Recognize tracking no. (OCR)" to fill it in.
hint.aiSettings: Configure the AI recognition provider's model choice and daily request limit.
hint.usersAdmin: Manage system user accounts, role permissions, and active status.
hint.notificationSettings: Configure which channels (LINE/Telegram/Email, etc.) receive your pickup notifications.
hint.notificationFailures: Review notifications that failed to send, and retry them.
